SOURCES / METHOD

How to read this atlas

The 52 entries are a selected set of major markets and named projects, not a facility census. The development and disclosure charts count selected entries. Country capacity and annual supply use separate published research; their coverage differs from the map and from each other.

Different capacity measures

Market inventory, estimated site load, planned IT capacity, power agreements and project targets are distinct. Select a location for its basis. “Unknown” means defensible numeric MW was not established.

Overlap and geography

Market aggregates can include projects shown separately. Coordinates represent a city, county or region. The underlying 3,840 × 2,400 map is a fixed image rendered from geographic boundaries; the interactive markers are a separate overlay.

Country capacity and growth

Country shares use rounded live IT capacity estimates published by RaboResearch in March 2026. The growth bars use the totals published in each CBRE year-end report, 2021–2025. These cover U.S. primary wholesale colocation markets, not all North American facilities. Market coverage changes: Hillsboro was secondary in 2021–2022 and primary by 2024. Values have not been reconciled to a fixed market set; no like-for-like growth percentage is calculated. Hover, tap or focus chart marks for values.

Download chart data and source links ↗

Three-year forecast

The 2027–2029 forecast uses Rystad Energy’s rounded North America facility-capacity projections from page 14 of its condensed Data Center Report 2026. These account for project delivery risk and include traditional, AI/HPC and crypto workloads. They are a separate measure from the IT-capacity pie and CBRE colocation series, so the charts must not be joined into a single time series. Forecasts can change; no confidence interval is supplied.

Verification

Direct operator or market report checks appear in relevant location details. Other values await row-level verification against operator disclosures, utility filings and planning approvals.
